follow-up time: Until pregnancy outcome or last follow-up
cohort: 14 women with a Cesarean scar pregnancy and a desire for future pregnancies
finding: Robot-assisted laparoscopic removal of Cesarean scar pregnancies with defect repair is feasible and associated with acceptable reproductive outcomes.
mod_finding: Robot-assisted laparoscopic surgery for Cesarean scar pregnancies resulted in successful pregnancies and Cesarean deliveries in a majority of the participants.
